ResearchProjectDef.label: "Overlord" project
ResearchProjectDef.description: Project "Overlord" was developed by an almost independent branch of one of the colonial fleets. When Renegade Crisis began they decided to join separatists, providing advanced command Automatroids for growing renegades army. Allows for the construction of advanced self-aware command Automatroids.

ResearchProjectDef.label: reality rifts
ResearchProjectDef.description: Draws energy from the quantum fluctuations of the vacuum itself. Once the principle is mastered, antiparticles can be consumed to produce solidified zero-point energy, which powers the most advanced machines and weapons. It is the threshold of transcendent technology. But the true cost of harnessing the void is something humanity has yet to fully understand.\n\nAfter the main battle ███ division that landed on planet ████ drove the transcendent machine ████ out of the planet's crust, where it had lain parasitic, in the year ████, colonial fleet ████ compiled a detailed account of how such transcendent beings are constituted and passed it by stele to the other colonial fleets operating in the Andromeda cluster. Because transcendent beings and their applications still contaminate the physical universe in ways that remain largely beyond control, disclosure of such technology to developing worlds is prohibited, and its related preventive technologies are to be declassified once a colonial world's society attains class II standard.
